# ExplorerFocus

> ExplorerFocus is a file explorer for Windows 11 and 10, a replacement for Windows Explorer built for people who always work in the same folders. Each profile is a tab with its own folders, filters and saved state. It adds a preview that opens almost anything, encrypted vaults, remote connections and file tools. It is made by mBrothers, a brand of Intrepid Parallel, Lda, in Lisbon, Portugal, and its interface is in 16 languages, including Portuguese from Portugal and from Brazil.

## What it does

- **Profiles:** each tab is a profile with its own tree of folders, so the folders of each piece of work are always one click away.
- **Preview:** code, Markdown, PDF, Word, Excel, e-books, images, video and audio, in a side pane or a separate window.
- **Encrypted vaults:** AES-256, in a format compatible with Cryptomator, readable on Android, iOS, macOS and Linux. They open as an ordinary drive letter.
- **Remote connections:** SFTP, FTP, WebDAV, Dropbox and OneDrive, in the same tree as local folders.
- **Tools:** PDF (merge, split and more), images, video and audio, text recognition (OCR), transcription and dictation, and translation, all running on the computer.
- **Operations that say what is happening:** copies and moves show progress and explain why when something cannot be done.

## The essentials

- **Windows 11, or Windows 10 version 1809 or later, 64-bit.**
- **One signed .exe, with no installer and nothing else to install** (self-contained, .NET 10 and WPF). A .zip is also available for organisations that block .exe downloads.
- **Free version with no time limit, no account and no ads.** PREMIUM adds more; the current price is on the website.
- **Privacy:** the app works on the computer; the only things it sends are listed on the privacy page, and the anonymous usage counts can be turned off.
- **Languages:** English (UK and US), Portuguese (Portugal), Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, French, Italian, German, Polish, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese and Korean.
- **Uninstalling:** About (the "i" button at the top right) → "Remove ExplorerFocus from this computer…".
